name: Toptive SEOpiloto AI Content Publisher
author: serbal

sections.description:
Toptive SEOpiloto AI Content Publisher is a powerful WordPress plugin that seamlessly integrates with the SEOpiloto platform to automatically publish AI-generated SEO-optimized content to your WordPress website.

Features

  • Automatic content publishing from SEOpiloto
  • Support for draft or immediate publishing
  • SEO meta data integration (Yoast, Rank Math, All in One SEO, SEOPress)
  • Featured image support
  • Category and tag management
  • Secure API key authentication
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/toptive-seopiloto-ai-content-publisher directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to SEOpiloto > Settings to configure the plugin.
  4. Generate an integration key in your SEOpiloto dashboard at https://seopiloto.com/integrations/new
  5. Enter the integration key in the plugin settings.
  6. Choose whether you want posts to be published as drafts or directly.
  7. Save your settings.
sections.faq:
Where do I get an integration key?

You can generate an integration key by creating a WordPress integration in your SEOpiloto dashboard.

Can I publish posts as drafts?

Yes! You can choose to have all incoming posts saved as drafts for review before publishing.

Which SEO plugins are supported?

The plugin supports Yoast SEO, Rank Math, All in One SEO, and SEOPress.
